fundamental.summary: CNP shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 25 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (549+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) dominates; FOMC event just passed (-2 days); normal yield curve provides limited offset; utilities defensive but macro stress is acute.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross and Donchian breakout provide technical structure, and extreme market fear (35/100) creates contrarian opportunity for defensive utility sector positioning.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis regime (VIX 36.7, post-FOMC stress), negative primary MACD, absent money flow confirmation, weak ADX trend strength, and earnings risk in 25 days overwhelm bullish technicals; zero fundamental/insider support.
